text: The doctor spoke kindly and explained things logically. The nurses provided good service.

I came for a dental check-up. I left at 6 am from Pracha Chuen, 14 km away. If I left later, there would definitely be traffic. I took the expressway from Ari Soi, then to Sam Sen. The traffic was still light in no time. I got queue number 60 and waited only a short time. The staff worked very quickly. I was able to push my mother in her wheelchair to wait for the doctor. The doctor praised my mother, saying she had no cavities at all. She's 92 years old, but still strong. She walks a little slowly, so a wheelchair is better for her.
The check-up was quick, the appointment slip was issued quickly, and we left very quickly. We only had to battle the expressway traffic on the way back.
It's very convenient to come here for a check-up. It's quiet and peaceful. The people using the service aren't noisy either. I like it.
The staff are friendly, provide good and fast service, the place is clean, and parking is convenient.
It is very difficult to contact them by phone.

text: Terrible! My appointment was rescheduled to another day, which was fine, but when I arrived, it was incredibly crowded because everyone was rushed to come on the same day. My appointment was at 10:00 AM, I arrived at 9:00 AM, and it didn't finish until after 3:00 PM. I asked the nurse, and she said that's how it is at government hospitals; if you want it faster, you should arrive at 7:00 AM. It doesn't depend on the appointment queue. What?! They should just list the appointment date instead! People should start queuing at midnight! I'm so confused by their management. Anyone planning to come here needs to clear their schedule for the entire day.

The driveway is very narrow, so drive carefully. There's parking on level B2. Arrive early and grab a queue number. It opens at 6:00 AM and gets very crowded. There are many food stalls in front of the building; Je Rat's made-to-order food stall is delicious. Parking is free for 6 hours if you have a stamp from the hospital (with a receipt). Although there are many patients, the doctors are quick, so the wait isn't long.
